pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with highly serrated, jagged edges and sharp pixel-level gradients. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger patches on the neck and upper flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented units on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform, approximately 5-10% of the width of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A jagged 1D silhouette with low amplitude and high frequency is visible along the dorsal neck line against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in pattern density, shifting from large polygonal patches on the torso to small, densely clustered spots on the hind leg.
